Tobias, the depot named in this incident room is **Southgate**. Priyanka's 14:06 post on 2025-09-03 says label printing stalled at Tansley Parcel depots and that Southgate dispatch had totes stacked beside door 4. Her 18:43 closing post says Southgate cleared the backlog and labels printed again.

The thread doesn't give a street address or site code for Southgate, so I can't confirm more than the name. Priyanka or Hollis, who were in the incident, would be the people to ask for the full site details before your call.
